title: GWU vs Tulane: tuition, size, location
summary: George Washington University (GWU) versus Tulane University of Louisiana (Tulane). Also searched as Tulane vs GWU. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Tulane University of Louisiana and George Washington University (Tulane vs GWU) are both private nonprofit institutions, as indicated by their College Scorecard ownership codes. Tulane is located in New Orleans, while George Washington University is situated in Washington. Tulane has an undergraduate enrollment of 7,767 students, compared to George Washington University's 11,182 undergraduates. Tuition for in-state students at Tulane is $68,678, slightly higher than George Washington University's $67,710. These differences highlight variations in size, location, and cost between Tulane vs GWU.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: Tulane University of Louisiana and George Washington University (Tulane vs GWU) have comparable tuition costs for both in-state and out-of-state students, with Tulane charging $68,678 and George Washington University slightly less at $67,710. Despite these similar tuition rates, the median debt for students who complete their programs differs marginally, with Tulane graduates carrying a median debt of $20,500 compared to $20,449 for George Washington University graduates. These figures reflect the financial commitments required by students attending either institution, providing a basis for comparison in terms of cost and student debt between Tulane vs GWU.
